description: You can follow allocation, two writes and release through an integer pointer.

steps.description: malloc requests space for five integers. You store the returned address in x.
The null check prints an allocation error but continues afterward. On the supplied successful path, you assign 6 and 7 to the first two elements.

steps.answer: It selects x[0], so it prints 6.
steps.question: Which assigned value does this printf select?

steps.description: You see 6 in the recorded output. The call to free then releases the allocation referenced by x.

title: Indexing an allocated integer array
